problem:
A snow sensor of mass $12\,\text{kg}$ falls vertically downward. Let $v(t)$ be the sensor’s velocity, in meters per second, $t\ge 0$ seconds after the fall began, with downward taken as the positive direction.
The air resistance acting on the sensor is negligible, and the only other force acting on it is the weight due to gravity. Which differential equation best models the velocity? Assume the acceleration due to gravity is $g.$

activity_context.topic_title: Falling Body Problems With Linear Drag
